ui.tip: Tip: In Auto you can clearly see the microtask checkpoint.
ui.defaultRule: When the Call Stack is empty, all Microtasks run before taking a Task.
ui.defaultWhy: That is why Promise callbacks run before setTimeout(0).
msg.compileNow: Compiled. Starting from sync execution (Call Stack).
msg.compileRule: Sync runs first. then/await → microtasks, timeout → tasks.
msg.compileWhy: The event loop decides queues, not magic.
msg.resetToy: Reset. Press Step (or Compile if you changed code).
msg.resetCustom: Reset. Press Step or Analyze for a new capture.
msg.modeToy: Toy mode: Press Compile to start.
msg.modeCustom: Custom JS mode: Press Step or Analyze for auto-capture.
msg.syncEnd: End of sync. Call Stack empty → microtask checkpoint.
msg.done: Done. No more work in queues.
msg.customDone: Custom replay finished. No more work.
msg.customCaptureRule: We capture scheduling + execution of microtasks/tasks.
msg.customCaptureWhy: This enables step-by-step replay in the same panels.
msg.customCaptureWarn: Stopped waiting for pending async tasks.
narrator.sync.rule: When the Call Stack is empty, all Microtasks run before taking a Task.
narrator.sync.why: Microtasks (Promise/await) have priority at each checkpoint.
narrator.checkpoint.rule: Microtasks drain until empty (they can create more microtasks).
narrator.checkpoint.why: This makes Promise.then appear to run before setTimeout(0).
narrator.task.rule: Tasks are taken one by one (FIFO). Then another microtask checkpoint.
toy.sync.await: await: pauses here and continuation goes to microtasks ("{text}")
toy.sync.asyncNoAwait: async block without await → all sync
toy.sync.asyncAwait: async/await: after await, continuation is a microtask (before timers).
toy.micro.asyncCont: Async/await continuation as microtask → logs and/or schedules queues.
toy.task.microInside: Inside a task you can schedule a microtask → it runs at the next checkpoint.
